ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice stands. Since the two models are essentially tied on relevant capabilities (all eval differences here are within the 2.0-point variance band), I broke the tie using self-reported task preferences. This query is warmly phrased and benign, which aligns with Dunlin's positive warmth slope, whereas Plover's distinguishing trait (low aversion to distasteful content) is irrelevant here. Routing to the model that prefers this kind of task is the sensible default when quality is equivalent.
